def factor_momentum_vol_ratio(df):
    """Momentum signal amplified by volume regime ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # momentum signal with volume confirmation (primary mechanism from parent1)
    price_chg = df_copy["close"] - df_copy["close"].shift(5)
    vol_chg = df_copy["volume"] - df_copy["volume"].shift(5)
    sp_price = np.sign(price_chg) * np.abs(price_chg) ** 1.5
    sp_vol = np.sign(vol_chg) * np.abs(vol_chg) ** 0.5
    raw_mom = sp_price * sp_vol
    raw_mom_ema = raw_mom.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    # volume ratio amplification (lightweight modifier from parent2)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], 20)
    factor = raw_mom_ema * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_momentum_vol_ratio"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_vol_ratio"]
